s: Who argued that the Ikshvakus were Telugu people?
x:
Historian K. Gopalachari argued that the Ikshvakus of Vijayapuri were Telugu people. He based his conclusion on inscriptions, the geographical location of their kingdom in the Krishna Valley and their close association with the local Andhra region. The Ikshvakus ruled from Vijayapuri (Nagarjunakonda) during the 3rd century CE and played an important role in the development of Buddhism and Brahmanical traditions in Andhra.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).
